attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as router/services host for the private 10.100.169.0/24 network shared with node2 and node3: gave it a fixed static address (10.100.169.10), enabled its dnsmasq DHCP server for the network, and added a firewall rule rejecting inbound TCP/23 from the lan zone. Verified all settings survive and continue serving live traffic after restarting node1, then completed the mandatory restart-and-recovery protocol on all three managed nodes with changed-boot-id proof and post-restart functional verification.
